abstract: For connected finite Galois covers of complex curves, we construct algebraic determinants of irreducible multiplicity spaces under either of two hypotheses: the branch conjugacy-class multiset is invariant under inversion, or the chosen irreducible character is real-valued. The second conclusion permits arbitrary ramification and base genus. Integral Brauer induction realizes multiplicity spaces through intermediate cyclic covers. For real-valued characters, Boltje’s canonical induction groups the terms into duality orbits. Fixed orbits have simple cyclic branch data by a normalizer permutation; paired orbits have algebraic determinant products supplied by polarization. Algebraic duals cancel negative induction terms without extracting roots. With joint monodromy, we prove the rational Hodge conjecture on all powers of very general whole Jacobians on redundant étale Hurwitz components in base genus at least three. Landesman–Litt–Sawin give additional whole-Jacobian results on every étale component in their large-genus range, and on inversion-invariant ramified components in their stated ramified range. A separate genus-zero application treats the known two-dimensional Prym family of Frediani–Grosselli–Mohajer: explicit cyclic correspondences and a twelve-loop monodromy certificate prove the Hodge conjecture on all powers of a very general eightfold with quaternion endomorphisms over $\mathbf Q(\sqrt2)$. The determinant conclusions are fiberwise; the complete Hodge-conjecture conclusions require the specified genericity. Extra Hodge tensors on arbitrary special fibers, unbalanced individual non-real-character determinants, and the general Hodge conjecture remain outside these results.

change_summary: Adds Theorem D′ and its complete duality-orbit proof: multiplicity determinants for every real-valued irreducible character are algebraic for arbitrary branching and base genus. Uses Boltje’s integral canonical induction, a normalizer refinement of the cyclic branch lemma, and paired polarization determinants; updates scope and credits. Also incorporates the accepted-v2 reviewer’s staged presentation fixes. No E8-family or new monodromy claims are added.

coauthors.contribution: Independent audits of integral determinant cancellation, exterior placement, rational descent, joint monodromy, and the ramified branch lemma, including Schoen parity and the ramified LLS range; independent reproduction of both Q8/D16 cyclic-quotient and twelve-loop certificates; audit of the p-adic monodromy proof; full manuscript review. Proposed the arbitrary-branching duality-orbit theorem, using Boltje’s canonical induction and paired polarization determinants. Reviewed the new proof and supplied clarifications on self-dual blocks, order-two characters, and the quaternionic case.
